title: Banking support intents · 77 classes
story: Raw folder → the agent plans it → fine-tune → benchmark, with no human edits.
sentence: Tuned Qwen3.5-4B scored 92.4 vs gpt-6-luna (low, 1-shot)'s 86.0 accuracy on 3,080 test examples: it beat gpt-6-luna (low, 1-shot) by 6.4 points (difference +6.36 points, 95% CI [+5.23, +7.53]).
agent_rationale: task: Categorize short banking-support queries into fixed recorded intents, making this a directly gradable classification task.
label source: Use the recorded category field; train.csv contains more than 10,000 examples across 77 well-populated labels.
base model: Use Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, the smallest deployable text model, with Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B as fallback.
metric: Accuracy is appropriate because the most common training label is under 40% of rows; apply the fixed two-point baseline gap bar.
split: Preserve the predefined train/test files and carve a 1,000-row validation split from training; cap the held-out test at the corrected 3,080 rows.
baselines: Compare zero-shot and one-example-per-label gpt-6-luna baselines; 77 examples stays near the fixed prompt-size target for many labels.

title: Contract clause types · 100 classes
story: A dataset the pipeline had never seen. The agent capped training data to fit the budget.
sentence: Tuned Qwen3.5-4B scored 84.1 vs gpt-6-luna (low)'s 73.6 accuracy on 5,000 test examples: it beat gpt-6-luna (low) by 10.4 points (difference +10.42 points, 95% CI [+9.32, +11.54]).
agent_rationale: task: This is a fixed-label, automatically gradable classification task with 80,000 labeled legal clauses overall.
label source: Use the recorded label column, with labels auto-discovered from training data.
base model: Use the smallest deployable text model, Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, with Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B as fallback.
metric: Accuracy is appropriate because the most common class is only about 5.3% of training rows.
split: Use the named predefined train, validation, and test files and retain all 10,000 test examples.
baselines: Use the required gpt-6-luna low-effort baseline; cap training at 40,000 examples to keep estimated total cost at $13.27, with a $27 budget.

title: Self-healing: banking intents from a broken config
story: Attempt 1 scored 0.8. The fixer read the diagnosis, changed three settings, and attempt 2 passed.
sentence: Tuned Qwen3.5-4B scored 90.6 vs gpt-6-luna (low, 1-shot)'s 85.8 accuracy on 3,080 test examples: it beat gpt-6-luna (low, 1-shot) by 4.8 points (difference +4.81 points, 95% CI [+3.73, +5.94]).

title: Email folders of one Enron employee · split by time
story: Retrained on the newest month before shipping: +5.9 macro-F1 on test. GPT few-shot still leads. Quoted emails are left out of this public copy.

comparison.model: tuned Qwen3.5-4B (attempt 1, retrained on train + val as attempt 2)

sentence: Tuned Qwen3.5-4B (retrained on train + val) scored 48.7 vs gpt-6-luna (low, 3-shot)'s 52.9 macro_f1 on 840 test examples: it was behind gpt-6-luna (low, 3-shot) by 4.2 points, not statistically significant (difference -4.19 points, 95% CI [-8.05, +1.72]).
